metadata_json.warning: Do not activate this template as law. Replace every placeholder with verified current statutory/procedural authority and lawyer-reviewed maintainability/limitation logic.

rules.description_en: Template for a verified appellate remedy rule. It deliberately contains no substantive Indian limitation period or maintainability conclusion.
rules.description_hi: सत्यापित अपीलीय उपचार नियम के लिए टेम्पलेट। इसमें जानबूझकर कोई वास्तविक सीमा अवधि या पोषणीयता निष्कर्ष नहीं दिया गया है।

forum_json.note: Populate from verified statute/rule and jurisdiction hierarchy.

limitation_json.note: Populate trigger, days, exclusions, condonation and controlling citation only after verification.

maintainability_json.note: This check alone does not establish appealability.

procedural_steps_json: Verify the enabling appellate provision and correct forum.
Verify limitation trigger, exclusions, condonation position and filing rules.
Collect certified/official copy and required record.
Prepare grounds and relief for lawyer review.
risks_json: Appealability, forum and limitation are placeholders until verified.
Interlocutory/final-order characterization may change the available remedy.
